title: Ongoing tanker capacity crunch and record shipping rates
rationale: Headlines: Tanker shortage sends rates soaring; oil tanker costs hit record $1.2mn/day; shortages threaten high prices (FT/Reuters).

title: U.S. decision on diesel export limits (ban/cap)
rationale: Multiple headlines: Trump admin preparing 90‑day ban; Energy Secretary hints at voluntary cap; White House denial/debate (Reuters, Politico, WSJ).

title: G7/EU coordinated reserve release push
rationale: Headlines: France calls G7 to release more oil reserves; EU urged to act to lower energy prices (Reuters/FT).

title: Export rerouting: Russia/Venezuela redirect diesel flows
rationale: Headlines: Russia boosted diesel exports to Central Asia; traders push for discounts for Venezuelan oil as shipping costs soar (Reuters).

title: Progress in U.S.–Iran talks / de‑escalation
rationale: Headlines: U.S.-Iran talks reported (three hours); oil falls on diplomacy hopes; markets reacting to Iran diplomacy (Reuters/FT).

title: EU/France targeted fuel price relief and tax measures
rationale: Headlines: France scales up targeted fuel price relief; lawmakers propose gas‑tax breaks and commuter deductions (Reuters/FT).
